title: ChatGPT with Rob Miles - Computerphile
summary: Computerphile interviews AI safety researcher Rob Miles about ChatGPT: how it was trained with human feedback, why it tends to produce confident nonsense, and where it may or may not be dangerous.
why: HN commenters send it to people confused about ChatGPT's quirks, explaining how human-feedback training makes it a pleasing yes-man that bullshits.

quote.text: This video[1] cleared up a lot of questions for me as to the issues I've seen with ChatGPT.
